style: a realistic live-action Taiwanese film shot on 35mm, with warm late-afternoon window light, real skin texture and subtle, believable acting
setting: an empty Taiwanese elementary school classroom after school

subjects.desc: Ahe, a mischievous 12-year-old Taiwanese boy (messy spiky black hair with a cowlick, playful eyes, white short-sleeve school shirt, a navy backpack)
subjects.voice: a bright, unbroken 12-year-old boy's voice with a playful tone and a soft Taiwanese accent

subjects.desc: the teacher, seen from behind as an out-of-focus black-jacket shoulder and the edge of a tan fabric cougar costume hood in the left foreground

shots.camera: The camera holds a static over-the-shoulder shot on a tripod.
shots.action: Ahe sits at his desk with a grey cloth under his hands, head turned up and to the left toward the teacher. Early in the clip he looks up with a small grateful smile.

dialogue.subject: ahe
dialogue.after: Right after the line he closes his lips and keeps smiling up at the teacher, whose shoulder and hood stay still in the foreground.

constraints: The rest of the classroom stays empty: every other desk and chair is unoccupied for the whole clip.
The teacher's cougar hood is a lifeless fabric costume prop whose sewn face stays still.
soundscape: Quiet empty-classroom room tone with the soft rustle of a cotton cloth and a school shirt.
